answer: Because the tide solution is checked at the whisper gate and logged, the tundra audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 22 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch as a result burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. That is 10 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
